## What's new

- **Pixel-perfect automap zoom (10%).** The map draws the automap at a tenth of its size, so at exactly 10% one automap pixel fills one screen pixel, as in game.
  - In Automap mode, **Home** and a click on the zoom percentage in the status bar now go to exactly 10% instead of 100%, with or without smooth zoom.
  - The automap editor's preview has its own zoom percentage next to Fit. Click it, or press **Home** in the editor, for exactly 10%.
- **A more compact automap texture picker.**
  - **Same size for every piece.** Every piece is shown in the same box at one whole-number size, 3× by default. Pieces stay where the game places them in their cell, with the empty space kept, so you can see which side of the cell a piece sits on. The few oversized pieces are cropped.
  - **1×–6× buttons** set the size, or hold **Ctrl** and scroll over the pieces.
  - **Numbers** and **Names** checkboxes hide the labels to fit more pieces. The tooltip still shows both. The size and the two checkboxes are remembered.
- **The automap editor's left side is reorganised.**
  - **Category tabs.** The five categories (Walls, Walkable floors, Water, Roofs, Objects & trees) are now a row of compact icon tabs. A dot marks a category with missing walls, and a dimmed icon marks one hidden from the automap.
  - **Category details.** Below the tabs: the chosen category's counts, its Show checkbox and its parts (Left walls, Right walls, Corners, Doors…).
  - **Tile kind list.** The list of tile kinds is always open and fills the rest of the column.
